# OT Potential - Occupational therapy continuing education


Online OT CEUs for only $99 per year. Live webinars and on-demand courses.


## Pages


- [Home](https://otpotential.com/): Online OT CEU courses via the OT Potential Podcast, live webinars, 2 free OT CEUs, OT Near Me Directory, OT treatment guides, clinical decision support, and more.
- [OT Potential Club](https://otpotential.com/ot-potential-club): Join OT Potential and take your OT practice to the next level with our suite of evidence-based tools, OT CEU courses, and community support.
- [Free OT CEUs](https://otpotential.com/free-ot-ceus): Get access to 2 of OT Potential’s online AOTA-approved OT CEU courses for free, with our free trial.
- [OT Near Me Directory](https://otpotential.com/occupational-therapy-directory): Looking for occupational therapy near you? Or looking to connect with fellow OT professionals?  Find OT professionals (occupational therapists and OTAs) worldwide.
- [What is OT / Occupational Therapy?](https://otpotential.com/what-is-ot): When a health condition makes life difficult, OT is here to help. In occupational therapy, we help clients change their habits to change their health—collaborating with them to set goals, problem-solve, and take action. OT is safe, cost-effective, and backed by scientific research.
- [Occupational Therapy Jobs](https://otpotential.com/occupational-therapy-jobs): Find full-time, part-time, or PRN occupational therapist jobs shared by members of OT Potential. Discover OT jobs near you, remote opportunities, and non-clinical jobs.
- [Occupational Therapy Assistant Jobs](https://otpotential.com/ota-jobs): Find full-time, part-time, or PRN occupational therapist assistant jobs shared by members of OT Potential. Discover OTA jobs near you, remote opportunities, and non-clinical jobs.

## Blog


- [Medbridge Promo Code and Review (#1 Best Discount 2025)](https://otpotential.com/blog/promo-code-for-medbridge): The OT Potential Medbridge promo code (code: OTP) gives you the BEST discount available. $101 off any individual plan.
- [30+ OT Certifications and Specialties](https://otpotential.com/blog/where-to-go-ot-degree): Here are the most popular OT certifications, both in pediatrics and adult-rehab. (This list will also be handy if you found this post trying to understand OT credentials!)
- [Your Occupational Therapy Salary Guide](https://otpotential.com/blog/occupational-therapy-salary-guide): In this guide we cover, OT job listings, average OT salary, OT salaries state-by-state, do OTs make a lot of money, new grad salaries, highest paying OT jobs, lowest paying OT jobs, OT salary growth, OT salaries vs PT salaries, and how to make more money as an OT.
- [Occupational Therapy Assistant Salary (for OTAs/COTAs)](https://otpotential.com/blog/occupational-therapy-assistant-salary-guide): We created this article to provide in-depth occupational therapy assistant salary data. Whether you’re still considering if a career as an OTA is right for you, looking at options for your first OTA job, or simply curious about how your pay compares to the national average, this article aims to give you a better idea of how much money OTAs tend to make in the US.
- [OT Notes (SOAP Examples, AI Tools, and Cheat Sheets!)](https://otpotential.com/blog/occupational-therapy-documentation): In this guide, you’ll find OT Potential’s list of documentation examples (available with paid membership), AI solutions for OT documentation, do’s and don’ts of OT documentation, OT documentation cheat sheets, and a sample OT evaluation.
- [Occupational Therapy Evaluation Assessments](https://otpotential.com/blog/occupational-therapy-assessments): Choosing the right occupational therapy assessments during your evaluation sets the stage for evidence-based OT practice. We are so passionate about helping OTs find the right assessment to kick-start their care. In this post, you’ll learn about our OT Assessment Search, and get to see a long list of the assessments found in it!
- [Occupational Therapy and CPT Codes](https://otpotential.com/blog/occupational-therapy-and-cpt-codes): It is essential that occupational therapy professionals understand CPT codes. In this post, we will walk you through the basics of using CPT codes, explain why they are so important, and supply you with a chart of reimbursement rates. (Both the actual numbers and adjusted for inflation.)
- [Pelvic Floor Therapy Near Me](https://otpotential.com/blog/pelvic-health-occupational-therapy): If you are ready to find a pelvic floor therapist, use the directory below to search for occupational therapists (OTs) with a focus area of pelvic floor therapy near you. Both OTs and physical therapists (PTs) can practice as pelvic floor specialists. Pelvic Rehab is another great resource for finding pelvic floor therapists!
- [Hand Therapy Near You (Find a CHT / OT!)](https://otpotential.com/blog/hand-therapy): Hand therapy is rehab of the hand, wrist, elbow and shoulder. If you’ve been injured, had a surgery, or have a condition that impacts using your arm, you may benefit from seeing a hand therapist. In this guide, we’ll begin by helping you find occupational therapists with a focus in hand therapy, as well as certified hand therapists near you. Then we’ll walk you through common hand therapy questions.
- [Outpatient OT (Guide & Directory)](https://otpotential.com/blog/your-outpatient-ot-guide): Here you’ll learn all about outpatient occupational therapy. You can also find an outpatient OT near you!
- [The Scoop on Traveling OT Jobs](https://otpotential.com/blog/traveling-occupational-therapy): In this post we will look at the top 10 OT travel jobs that are currently open—and, share an interview with Emily Butler who can help you determine whether traveling is the right career move for you. Then, at the end, we will share a bit about our favorite travel advocate, Nomadicare.
